card.name: Space before infusion rate numbers
card.fires_on: The space just before a number giving an infusion rate or daily amount, such as after 'at a rate of' or 'should not exceed', mostly in parenteral nutrition dosing text. Also digits inside such rate numbers.

modes.label: Space before rate number
modes.description: The space after a rate or limit phrase, right before the amount.
modes.example: the hourly infusion rate should not exceed<< >>0.75 mL/kg/hour

modes.label: Digits inside rate
modes.description: The digits within a rate value such as 60 to 70 mL/kg.
modes.example: half strength at a rate of about 6<<0>> to 70 mL/kg/day.
